"""Literal pre-load style/graph comparison; no renderer or support vote."""
import collections
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys

repo = Path('/Users/dli/dev/libdxfrw')
root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(repo / 'tools'))
from bounded_process import run_bounded

def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()

def probe(path):
    p = run_bounded([str(root / 'readiness_probe'), str(path)], timeout=15, output_limit=65536)
    assert p.returncode == 0, p.stderr
    return json.loads(p.stdout)

def styles(path):
    lines = Path(path).read_text().splitlines()
    assert len(lines) % 2 == 0
    records, current = [], []
    for i in range(0, len(lines), 2):
        pair = (int(lines[i]), lines[i + 1])
        if pair[0] == 0:
            if current and current[0] == (0, 'VISUALSTYLE'):
                records.append(current)
            current = [pair]
        else:
            current.append(pair)
    rows, fallbacks = {}, set()
    for rec in records:
        marker = next(i for i, (c, v) in enumerate(rec) if c == 291)
        before, after = rec[:marker], rec[marker + 1:]
        group = []
        for code, value in after:
            if code == 176:
                true_colors = [int(v) for c, v in group if c == 420]
                if true_colors:
                    assert len(true_colors) == 1
                    index = next(int(v) for c, v in group if c == 62)
                    fallbacks.add((true_colors[0], index))
                group = []
            else:
                group.append((code, value))
        handle = int(next(v for c, v in rec if c == 5), 16)
        rows[handle] = dict(handle=handle,
            sourceStyleType=int(next(v for c, v in before if c == 70)),
            propertyCounts=[int(v) for c, v in after if c == 70],
            sourceCompanions=sum(c == 176 for c, v in after))
    return rows, sorted(fallbacks)

style_rows = []
for year in (2018, 2013, 2010):
    source = Path(f'/private/tmp/libdxfrw-graph-readiness.jzaELF/oda-{year}/rtext_arctext.dxf')
    (expected, fallbacks), observed = styles(source), probe(source)
    actual = {o['handle']: o for o in observed['styles']}
    assert actual.keys() == expected.keys() and len(actual) == 24
    mismatches = []
    for handle, before in expected.items():
        value = actual[handle]
        assert not value['bodyDecoded'] and value['sourceCompanions'] == 0
        assert value['type'] == (58 if year >= 2013 else before['sourceStyleType'])
        if value['type'] != before['sourceStyleType']:
            mismatches.append(dict(before, typedType=value['type']))
    assert len(mismatches) == (24 if year >= 2013 else 0)
    assert observed['rawStyles'] == 24 and observed['sourceFormat'] == 1
    style_rows.append(dict(year=year, source=str(source), sourceSha256=sha(source),
        styleCount=24, typedTypeMismatches=len(mismatches), rows=mismatches,
        literalTrueColorFallbackPairs=fallbacks,
        rawStyleCompanions=observed['rawStyles'],
        conclusion='Raw carrier presence/read success does not certify typed style-type or expanded-property decode'))

graph_rows = []
for stem in ('rtext_arctext', 'mpolygon_solid', 'large_radial'):
    source = repo / f'tests/fixtures/dwg/{stem}.dwg'
    peer_path = Path(f'/private/tmp/libdxfrw-broader-boundaries.eCaIDz/{stem}-peer.json')
    peer = json.loads(peer_path.read_text())
    by_handle = {o['handle'][2]: o for o in peer['OBJECTS'] if 'handle' in o}
    observed = probe(source)
    assert observed['sourceFormat'] == 2 and observed['hasRoot'] == 1 and observed['root'] == 12
    root_dict = next(o for o in observed['dictionaries'] if o['handle'] == observed['root'])
    source_root = by_handle[observed['root']]
    entries = [(bytes.fromhex(e['keyHex']).decode(), e['target']) for e in root_dict['entries']]
    assert entries == [(k, v[-1]) for k, v in source_root['items'].items()]
    retained = {o['handle']: o['family'] for o in observed['nodes']}
    defaulted = {o['handle']: o['family'] for o in observed['inheritedDefaultCallbacks']}
    assert not (set(defaulted) & set(retained))
    dictionary_defaults = []
    for value in observed['dictionaryDefaultReferences']:
        target = value['defaultTarget']
        peer_dictionary = by_handle[value['handle']]
        assert target == peer_dictionary['defaultid'][-1]
        assert defaulted.get(target) == 'ACDBPLACEHOLDER'
        dictionary_defaults.append(dict(value, peerFamily=by_handle[target]['object'],
            sourceDefaultRole=peer_dictionary['defaultid'][0],
            targetOwner=by_handle[target]['ownerhandle'][-1],
            targetRetained=target in retained))
    direct, missing_descendants, planner_excluded = [], [], []
    dictionaries = {o['handle']: o for o in observed['dictionaries']}
    for key, handle in entries:
        direct.append(dict(key=key, handle=handle, peerFamily=by_handle[handle]['object'],
                           retainedFamily=retained.get(handle), inheritedDefault=defaulted.get(handle)))
        if handle not in dictionaries:
            continue
        for child in dictionaries[handle]['entries']:
            target = child['target']
            family = by_handle.get(target, {}).get('object', 'UNKNOWN')
            item = dict(rootKey=key, dictionary=handle,
                        childKey=bytes.fromhex(child['keyHex']).decode(), target=target,
                        peerFamily=family, inheritedDefault=defaulted.get(target))
            if target not in retained:
                missing_descendants.append(item)
            elif retained[target] not in ('DICTIONARY', 'XRECORD', 'VISUALSTYLE'):
                planner_excluded.append(dict(item, retainedFamily=retained[target]))
    cmc = collections.Counter()
    rgb_fallback = set()
    for style in (o for o in peer['OBJECTS'] if o.get('object') == 'VISUALSTYLE'):
        for key in ('face_mono_color', 'edge_intersection_color', 'edge_obscured_color',
                    'edge_color', 'edge_silhouette_color', 'c_prop29', 'c_prop2c', 'c_prop33'):
            raw = int(style[key]['rgb'], 16)
            cmc[hex(raw >> 24)] += 1
            if raw >> 24 == 0xc2:
                rgb_fallback.add(raw & 0xffffff)
    graph_rows.append(dict(source=str(source.relative_to(repo)), sha256=sha(source),
        peerSha256=sha(peer_path), rootEntryCount=len(entries), exactRootEntryJoin=True,
        directRootTargets=direct, inheritedDefaultCounts=dict(collections.Counter(defaulted.values())),
        unretainedDictionaryDefaultReferences=dictionary_defaults,
        oneLevelMissingRetained=missing_descendants,
        oneLevelRetainedButNotExtensionPlannerFamilies=planner_excluded,
        cmcMethods=dict(cmc), distinctRgbValues=sorted(rgb_fallback),
        scope='Root and one-level dictionary descendants only; selected adapter collections/default callbacks, not all objects or full transitive closure'))

print(json.dumps(dict(schema='libdxfrw-serializer-graph-readiness-research-v1',
    qualificationEligible=False, styleRows=style_rows, graphRows=graph_rows,
    sourceSha256={str(repo / p): sha(repo / p) for p in
        ('src/drw_objects.cpp', 'src/drw_objects.h', 'dwg2dxf/dx_data.h',
         'dwg2dxf/dx_iface.h', 'dwg2dxf/dx_iface.cpp')},
    artifactSha256={str(p): sha(p) for p in (root / 'readiness_probe', root / 'readiness_probe.cpp', repo / 'build/libdxfrw.a')},
    probeRecipe=(root / 'readiness_probe.cpp').read_text(), recipe=Path(__file__).read_text())))

    values = [[(c, v) for c, v in g] for g in groups]
    values[6][0] = (62, fallback)

    entity.acad_xdata = Tags([DXFTag(c, v) for c, v in [(70, 58)] + [t for g in values for t in g]])
    dictionary['LOCAL_' + label] = entity

outdir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)

"""Verify durable evidence bindings without rerunning a CAD converter/suite."""
import ast
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

repo = Path('/Users/dli/dev/libdxfrw')
receipt = json.loads((repo / 'docs/research/broader-style-closure-readiness-2026-10-15.json').read_text())
scratch = Path(receipt['scratchDirectory'])
packet = receipt['executedCurrentCode']
checks = 0

def bound(path, expected):
    global checks
    assert hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == expected, path
    checks += 1

for path, value in packet['sourceSha256'].items(): bound(path, value)
for path, value in packet['artifactSha256'].items(): bound(path, value)
for row in packet['styleRows']: bound(row['source'], row['sourceSha256'])
for row in packet['graphRows']:
    bound(repo / row['source'], row['sha256'])
    assert sum(row['inheritedDefaultCounts'].values()) == 29
    assert len(row['oneLevelMissingRetained']) == 27
    assert len(row['oneLevelRetainedButNotExtensionPlannerFamilies']) == 5
assert [x['typedTypeMismatches'] for x in packet['styleRows']] == [24, 24, 0]
assert receipt['identicalReadOnlySecondPacket']
calibration = receipt['authoredProducerCalibration']
bound(scratch / 'authored-input/local_profiles-first.dxf', calibration['firstInput']['sourceSha256'])
bound(scratch / 'authored-output/local_profiles-first.dxf', calibration['firstConversion']['outputSha256'])
bound(calibration['finalInput']['source'], calibration['finalInput']['sourceSha256'])
bound(scratch / 'authored-output/local_profiles.dxf', calibration['finalConversion']['outputSha256'])
assert calibration['finalLiteralObservations']['sourceSha256'] == calibration['finalInput']['sourceSha256']
assert calibration['finalLiteralObservations']['outputSha256'] == calibration['finalConversion']['outputSha256']
for value in (packet['recipe'], calibration['firstInput']['recipe'], calibration['finalInput']['recipe'],
              calibration['finalConversion']['recipe'], calibration['finalLiteralObservations']['recipe']):
    ast.parse(value)
prior = json.loads((repo / 'docs/research/broader-visualstyle-graph-readiness-2026-10-15.json').read_text())
flat = prior['odaConversionCalibration']['rows'][0]['flatLiteralRecord']
assert [2, 'Flat'] in flat and any(c == 291 for c, v in flat)
assert sum(c == 176 for c, v in flat) == 58
assert all(v == 'DEFERRED_EXTERNAL' for v in receipt['externalGates'].values())
for path in ('DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md', 'DWG_DXF_3D_SUPPORT_PLAN.md'):
    text = (repo / path).read_text()
    assert 'broader-style-closure-readiness-2026-10-15.json' in text
    assert 'typed-readback-whole-root-and-profile-discriminator-readiness-review-2026-10-15' in text
print(json.dumps(dict(status='PASS', hashBindings=checks, pythonRecipes=5,
    durableTemplate58Companions=True, gateStatesUnchanged=True,
    sourceAndArtifactReusedNotRebuilt=True, noFullSuiteOrConverterRerun=True,
    recipe=Path(__file__).read_text())))
